subject: Safeguard Exhibit & MSA Addendum — redline coordination for on‑prem deployment
messages:
From: Dr. Anil Mehta <anil.mehta@helionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: On‑prem licensing boundary and 'safeguard exhibit' ask

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Helion is ready to move forward but procurement and our security team want tighter language for the on‑prem deployment path. Two quick asks we hope you can address:

  - We need a clear exhibit for 'safeguards' that describes the transfer/validation process for snapshots and the limited audit access window. Our compliance team calls this a safeguarding exhibit rather than a traditional escrow.
  - For operator access during an audit, can you confirm what logs and runbooks you'll commit to ship to us, and whether those can be retained by Helion for 90 days after any access event?

I've attached our SOW (Helion_SOW_v3.pdf) showing timelines that will drive the PO. If you can propose redline language or a short exhibit, procurement can circulate a PO thereafter.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of feasibility and an ETA for a first redline.

Best,
Dr. Anil Mehta
Head of Platform Security
Helion Health

Attachment: Helion_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Anil Mehta <anil.mehta@helionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: On‑prem licensing boundary and 'safeguard exhibit' ask

Karthik, Laura — looping you in for legal and delivery alignment.

Summary of Helion's asks (from Anil):
  - A "Safeguard Exhibit" in the MSA/Addendum that outlines snapshot transfer, validation, and a narrow audit access window
  - Commitment to deliver runbooks/log exports and a 90‑day retention of artifacts post any vendor access event

Proposal from my side: we draft a short exhibit that keeps the handoff process prescriptive but avoids long term custody obligations. I attach a first pass redline (MSA_Addendum_SafeguardExhibit_redline_v1.docx). Key tradeoffs to consider: retention duration, who bears cost for forensic snapshots, and whether the exhibit creates an ongoing escrow obligation.

Requested from legal: please review the attached and provide two alternatives: (A) procurement‑friendly language with 90‑day retention and limited transfer rights; (B) minimal legal parity language with a 30‑day retention but stronger vendor control language.

Timeline: Helion wants a redline by Friday 10/15 to keep PO cadence. Can we target that?

Marissa
Sr. Account Exec, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MSA_Addendum_SafeguardExhibit_redline_v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Anil Mehta <anil.mehta@helionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Re: On‑prem licensing boundary and 'safeguard exhibit' ask

Marissa — thanks for the context and draft. Attaching inline notes below for the team. I prefer we present both options A and B to Helion so they can pick the acceptable balance.

Inline summary of proposed legal snippets (high level):
  - Exhibit: define 'Safeguard Snapshot' as a time‑limited, read‑only image produced on vendor infrastructure for verification, not an ongoing transfer of code or IP.
  - Audit window: vendor agrees to provide temporary console access or a live verification session up to 8 hours per audit event; Helion may request exports of execution logs and a signed transfer manifest.
  - Retention: Option A: vendor to produce artifacts and Helion may retain them up to 90 days following an access event (Helion responsible for secure storage). Option B: vendor retains artifacts for 30 days and exports upon request; vendor assists with retention export for an agreed cost.
  - Cost and scope carveout: any forensic snapshot creation beyond standard diagnostics will be billable per schedule in the Order Form.

Question for delivery: Laura, can Redwood support a time‑boxed live verification session (8 hours) and produce the runbook/log exports in the formats Helion specified (syslog + structured trace)? If not, propose the minimal change.

I will clean these into redline language and return both Option A and B by COB Friday, 10/15.

Karthik Iyer
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference

From: Sourcing Team <sourcing@helionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Helion PO and vendor attestation question

Marissa, Karthik — attaching the PO from procurement. We prefer Option A (90‑day retention) but need to confirm one thing before issuing the PO: will Redwood sign a short vendor attestation that you will only use any Helion artifacts for verification and will not store Helion data outside of the transfer manifest?

PO attached: Helio_PO_091227.pdf

If Redwood can accept a one‑page attestation (we drafted a template), procurement will push the PO through this week. Also include any lead time or separate billing line for forensic snapshot creation.

Thanks —
Helion Sourcing

Attachment: Helio_PO_091227.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Anil Mehta <anil.mehta@helionhealth.com>, Sourcing Team <sourcing@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helion PO and vendor attestation question

Thanks Helion team — we appreciate the clarity and the PO. Quick reply with next steps so procurement has what it needs:

  1) Attestation: Redwood can accept a one‑page vendor attestation that limits use of any exported artifacts to verification and prohibits persistent storage by Redwood. Karthik has drafted a short attestation paragraph and we'll attach it to the Order Form for signature.
  2) Exhibits and redlines: attached are the two finalized redlines (Option A = 90‑day retention; Option B = 30‑day retention + billable export). Please review and indicate preference. We recommend Option A to match your compliance ask.
  3) Billing note: forensic snapshot creation beyond the standard verification session will be billed per the Order Form line item 'Forensic Export Services' with an estimate provided upfront.
  4) Timeline: if Helion signs the attestation and PO by 10/27 we can target an internal delivery readiness call on 11/03 and a pilot install the week of 11/10.

DocuSign link for the attestation + Order Form bundle: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/AAABBBCCCDDDEEE

If you confirm Option A and route the PO, I'll coordinate the signature package and set a short legal call to finalize.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Exec, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
